name: blink-camera-mcp
description: Control an Amazon Blink camera and its pan/tilt mount, and capture a frame.
long_description:
An MCP server for Amazon Blink cameras, including the pan/tilt mount that Blink's own app can move but its API cannot.

Ask where the camera is pointing and what its travel limits are, aim it by absolute or relative angle, send it back home, run a 360 degree overview sweep, and take a snapshot. Moves are closed loop: the tool waits for the mount to report that it has stopped moving and returns the angle the hardware confirmed, so a caller never has to guess whether a command landed.

The server talks to Blink the same way the phone app does, which means it shares one liveview slot per camera with that app. Credentials are yours; if your account has two-factor verification, the code is read from a file you point it at and never passed on a command line.

blink_username.title: Blink account email
blink_username.description: The email address you sign in to the Blink app with.

blink_password.title: Blink account password
blink_password.description: Kept in your operating system's keychain, not in this file.

blink_2fa_file.title: 2FA code file
blink_2fa_file.description: Only if Blink asks for a verification code: the path to a file where you write that 6-digit code. Leave empty otherwise.

blink_camera_name.title: Camera name
blink_camera_name.description: Which camera to drive when the account has more than one. Leave empty to use the only camera.

blink_ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg path
blink_ffmpeg.description: Needed only for snapshots, and only when ffmpeg is not already on your PATH.
